a multiparametric evaluation approach can be used to identify structure-function-activity relationships in nanoparticles, improve in vitro screening, and identify key determinants of nanoparticle performance.

the development of lipid nanoparticles (LNP) that deliver siRNA to the liver in vivo.
the development of lipid-based nanocarriers for siRNA delivery and the identification of structure–function–biological activity relationships for these nanocarriers.
the development of lipid nanoparticles (LNP) as delivery vehicles for siRNAs.

the use of multiple parameters associated barriers to delivery may serve as a prescreening tool to identify the most promising candidates to be tested in vivo.
